gaps.explanation: Governmental funds statement (p4) prints General Fund, Street Fund and Keno Fund columns; none has a schedule of its own (the p8 budget schedule is all funds combined with the utilities and is not recorded). Only the Property taxes row is in detail[] (County Treasurer schedule p13, 211,642 = General 193,943 + Street 17,699), so it is not added again. Added: General Fund 778,330 - 193,943 = 584,387 (Sales and other taxes 118,219 split per p8 into Sales tax 111,444 + Other state receipts 6,775, as on the statement lines; Fees, taxes, permits and licenses 24,904; State shared receipts 163,280; Charges for services 52,519; Grant proceeds 202,696; Investment Income 7,334; Miscellaneous 15,435); Street Fund 239,641 - 17,699 = 221,942 (Sales and other taxes 28,235; Fees, taxes, permits and licenses 12,387; State shared receipts 176,226; Investment Income 1,495; Miscellaneous 3,599); Keno Fund Operating receipts 178,883. 584,387 + 221,942 + 178,883 = 985,212 = gap; 211,642 + 985,212 = 1,196,854 = statement Total revenues (p4).
